sentences.en: People come here to be healed from various ailments.
sentences.zh: 人们来这里治疗各种疾病。

sentences.en: People come to this bath to be healed from various ailments.
sentences.zh: 人们来这个温泉浴场治疗各种疾病。

sentences.en: The doctor said that this ailment is incurable.
sentences.zh: 医生说这种疾病无法治愈。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：a（一个）+il（看作ill，病）+ ment→一个ill→疾病
